en: The Hymn of One Hundred and Eight Names of Vajrapāṇi:
O Vajrasattva, Great Being, the Great Vehicle, the Great-Souled One;
O Great Radiance, Great Purity, Great Protector—homage be to you! (1)
O Vajrarāja, Great Vajra, Vajra of all Tathāgatas, Great Being, Great Hero, Great Skillful Means—homage be to you! || 2 ||
O Vajrarāga, greatly pure, great bliss of all happiness, supreme bliss without beginning or end, O Great Desire, homage be to you! (3)
O Vajrasādhu, great satisfaction, you who grant applause and bring joy;
O great rapture, great delight, supreme gladness, homage be to you! (4)
O Vajraratna, Great King, O Great-Minded One who bestows your own consecration;
O Great Splendor of all jewels, adorned with magnificent ornaments, homage be to you! (5)
O Vajra-splendor, O Great Splendor, O Vajra-light, O Great Radiance!
O Conqueror’s Light, O Great Flame, O Buddha-light, homage be to you! (6)
O Vajraketu, Great Banner, Great Standard, Bestower of Wealth;
O Ākāśaketu, Great Pole, Banner of Renunciation, homage be to you! (7)
O Vajrahāsa, O Mahāhāsa, O you who gladden with great joy! O Prītivega, O Ratiprīte, O Dharmaprīte, homage be to you! || 8 ||
O Vajradharma, Great Dharma, purifier of all phenomena;
O Buddha-Dharma, supreme and excellent Dharma, whose nature is passion—homage be to you! 9.
O Vajratīkṣṇa, great treasury, great-minded one of wisdom-knowledge;
O great sword that severs evil, weapon of the Buddhas, homage be to you! (10)
O Vajra-cause, Great Wheel, Buddha-wheel, Great Treasure!
O Foremost of all maṇḍala-dharmas, Wheel of Dharma, homage be to you! 11.
O Vajra-speech, great speech, free from conceptual proliferation, the great syllable;
O you who are beyond syllables, the great recitation, the voice of the Buddhas—homage be to you! 12.
Vajra-action, supreme among good actions, great action, performer of auspicious deeds;
O secret worship, great worship, worship of the Buddhas—homage be to you! (13)
O Vajra-protector, great armor, supreme coat of mail, most firm;
O great protection, great essence, Buddha-vigor, homage be to you! 14.
O Vajrayakṣa, great wrathful one, terrifying to all the wicked;
O supreme Yakṣa, the great skillful means of all Buddhas—homage be to you! (15)
O Great Union, O Great Seal, O Binder of the Great Samaya! O Great Fist, supreme among mudrās, O Vajra-fist, homage be to you! (16)
You are to be saluted, honored, worshipped, and treated with respect by the Tathāgatas, because you are said to be the bodhicitta that is without beginning or end. (17)
Having relied upon you, all the Victors and the heroic Bodhisattvas have arisen and will arise as the supreme causes for the enlightenment of a Buddha. (18)
Homage to you, Vajrasattva; homage to you, Vajraratna.
Homage to you, Vajradharma; homage to you, Vajrakarman. || 19 ||
By whatever merit is gained from praising you with the foremost names and bowing with sincere devotion, may everyone indeed attain the enlightenment of a Buddha. (20)
One established in excellent devotion should properly recite this supreme hundred-and-eight names even once; one shall attain the state of all Buddhas. || 21 ||
The hymn of one hundred and eight names of Śrī Vajrapāṇi is complete.
